$comment: Bundler mode (ts.compiler.3): a package the bundler reads emits nothing; the bundler resolves its imports and a relative import carries its .ts extension. The contract is read from its source, never from its dist: its build writes into the tree, and the members (typecheck, lint, test) must write nothing under the checkout (test/members-write-nothing.test.ts). packages/core/vitest.config.ts carries the same two names.
